Multimedia

Strategic Creative Applications

Strategic design thinking applied across audio, visual, and motion. Each project applies behavioral economics principles to solve communication challenges: considering color psychology, audio timbre, and evidence-based creative decisions to deliver measurable engagement and emotional resonance. Working backwards from defined objectives with iterative, user-consulted processes.

Product · Web Application

SEC Filings Tracker MVP

An MVP web application designed to monitor and surface SEC filings in near real time, with a focus on reducing information overload and improving signal detection. The project involved examining how users interpret regulatory disclosures, structuring data for clarity and relevance, and designing interaction patterns that support timely, informed review of complex filings.

Audio · Strategic Multimedia

BLM Movement Anthem

A strategic multimedia project examining how music and narrative can function as tools for mobilization within social movements. Applied principles from behavioral psychology and audience dynamics to design emotionally resonant content intended to support engagement during the COVID-19 lockdown period. Combined aggressive electronic and metal elements with a militant march structure to reinforce urgency and collective identity. Production involved coordinating asynchronous contributions from multiple artists and overseeing composition, mixing, and mastering to maintain coherence across distributed inputs.

While the original grassroots adoption goal was not realized, the work was independently selected for distribution by Sony Music's The Orchard, reaching a broad audience and demonstrating the wider viability of strategic genre fusion as an engagement mechanism.

Design · Redesign

Design & Redesign Solutions

Strategic design applied to clarify user experience challenges, address accessibility barriers, and improve consistency across touchpoints. Projects emphasize understanding how people interact with systems, identifying friction, and using evidence and iteration to support clearer, more usable outcomes.

Pinterest UX Enhancement Study

A UX analysis examining how users navigate and interact with core Pinterest features, focusing on identifying friction points, assessing interface clarity, and evaluating how small design adjustments could improve usability, efficiency, and overall user experience.

Multi-lingual YourPeer Service Flyer

A design and content revision project aimed at improving accessibility for a linguistically diverse audience, examining language clarity, layout hierarchy, and cultural considerations to ensure essential service information was understandable and approachable across multiple languages.

Social Media Branding Frame

A strategic frame developed to bring greater consistency and coherence to social media presence across platforms, aligning visual elements, tone, and structure to reduce fragmentation and support clearer brand recognition. The deliverables are a branded IG post border and a generic frame, reusable assets that establish visual continuity without constraining content adaptability.

Motion Graphics · Animation

Motion Graphics & Animation

Motion and audio design as strategic tools for shaping attention and reinforcing brand identity. Projects focus on how movement, timing, and sound support comprehension, emotional resonance, and continuity across experiences.

YourPeer Logo Animation & Jingle

A motion and audio design project exploring how short-form animation and sound cues can reinforce brand recognition and support smoother transitions across digital experiences.

A branding-focused motion design project showing how short transition animations reduce ambiguity during unavoidable loading states, using movement, timing, and brand cues to signal system status and maintain continuity.

Audio Production · Engineering

Audio Production & Engineering

Translating artistic vision into commercially viable productions with global distribution. Signature methodology: "Remix as Original" treats an initial mix as source material for further creative manipulation, enabling iterative exploration while maintaining coherence through multi-layer processing, dynamic texture integration, and multi-pass enhancement.

Technical Enhancement

Technical Enhancement Services

Transforming raw or uneven technical materials into polished, accessible assets that better support organizational communication goals. Projects emphasize professional post-production enhancements that improve clarity, accessibility, and audience engagement without compromising authenticity.

Streetlives / YourPeer Promotional Video Enhancement

Post-production enhancements to the "Introducing, YourPeer!" promotional video for Streetlives, a New York City-based nonprofit supporting unhoused individuals and families through digital tools. Work included title card design and integration, closed captioning, noise reduction, dialogue and music enhancement, level balancing, and dynamic range optimization for consistent playback across devices.
